question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Why are you calling her the much amazing woman?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the word "**much**" before **"amazing woman".**
 
• Instead of "**much**", the correct word to use is "**most**" to express a superlative degree.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**the most amazing woman**", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Why are you calling her the** most **__amazing woman?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "amazing woman?"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 2: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
 
• **Part 3: "Why are you calling"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "her the much,"** – **This part of the sentence contains the error as discussed.**
